title: A Best-practice Model for Online Teaching With Feedback Driven Video Analysis in Surgical Skills Training
reason: Describes an online surgical-skills course with video upload and feedback: submission compliance by task and satisfaction survey are reported descriptively. Video submissions are not scored into indicators related to skill outcome or a trait; no inferential analysis.

extraction.design: descriptive course evaluation (4 iterations) plus survey
